question: The value of 8000 ÷ 10 × {(8 - 4) + (36 - 24)} is:
solution:
**Given**

8000 ÷ 10 × {(8 - 4) + (36 - 24)}

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47485e25d1b30c57dc271863db8b99be0c8e209069b2596cc885911d898a8a78.png] 

**Calculation:**

8000 ÷ 10 × {(8 - 4) + (36 - 24)}

⇒ 8000 ÷ 10 × {4 + 12}

⇒ 8000 ÷ 10 × 16

⇒ 800 × 16

⇒ 12800

**Hence, the value of the expression is 12800.**
